title: 'The View' co-hosts agree Democrats should not impeach Trump if party wins back control of Congress
summary: Former Vice President Kamala Harris warned Democrats against impeaching President Donald Trump, and "The View" co-hosts agreed the focus should be on accountability and investigations.

title: Nicki Minaj torches Kathy Hochul as 'evil woman,' and the governor fires back with Trump jab
summary: Nicki Minaj branded Kathy Hochul an "evil woman" and urged New York voters to back Republican Bruce Blakeman in the gubernatorial race.

title: Liberal court delivers immigration win for Trump as judge warns of ‘floodgates’ if law firm succeeded
summary: The Ninth Circuit ruled that law firm Red Eagle lacked standing to challenge the State Department's indefinite pause on the diversity visa lottery.

title: Americans 'frustrated' about Iran war going into midterms as Trump admin has decision to make: GOP lawmaker
summary: House Armed Services Committee member Pat Harrigan says the U.S., in the ongoing conflict against Iran, must "do what it takes to either win or come home."

title: California election workers hit with criminal subpoenas as Trump DOJ turns up heat in voting showdown
summary: The Department of Justice issued criminal grand jury subpoenas to at least four California election workers over alleged noncitizen voting records.

title: 4 US cities are the lucky winners of Trump's $300M crime crackdown contest
summary: Jacksonville, Baton Rouge, Jackson and St. Louis will split nearly $300 million in DOJ Model Cities Initiative funding to combat violent crime.

title: Trump-backed Alaska candidate blasts 'so-called Republican' Murkowski for endorsing Dem
summary: Trump-backed Alaska gubernatorial candidate Bernadette Wilson slammed Sen. Lisa Murkowski for endorsing her Democratic opponent, accusing the two of sharing liberal economic policies.

title: Dem probes could ‘torture’ young Trump officials with crushing legal bills, subpoenaed conservative warns
summary: Rachel Bovard of CPI warns Democrats could follow Jack Smith's playbook to target young Trump administration officials with costly subpoenas.

title: JuJu Watkins says she's dreamed of her first basket since ACL injury as USC looks to end title drought
summary: JuJu Watkins returns to USC women's basketball after rehabbing an ACL tear, joining Jazzy Davidson in a loaded backcourt chasing a national title.

title: Ex-NBA player says LeBron James should 'stand the f--- still' during national anthem
summary: Jason Williams unleashed an expletive-filled rant on his podcast about LeBron James' national anthem habits, claiming the NBA star deserved a fine.
